title: Tangent and Normal Lines to Square Root Curve
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find equations of the tangent and normal lines to y = sqrt(x) at (4, 2).

steps.title: Compute Derivative at x = 4 via Limit
steps.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by conjugate sqrt(4+h) + 2.

steps.title: Write Tangent Line Equation
steps.explanation: Apply point-slope formula with slope 1/4 and point (4, 2).

steps.title: Write Normal Line Equation
steps.explanation: The normal slope is the negative reciprocal -4.
steps.why: Normal line is perpendicular to the tangent line.
